description: In the Houston dining shortlist, Sterling estimated Street to Kitchen (Second Ward) at ~25-28 min from the Hilton Houston Westchase and recommended it as the Wednesday pick partly on that basis. David corrected: the real drive is 45 minutes. All drive times in the shortlist were inferred from Michelin listing coordinates as off-peak straight-line estimates, not actual routing, and the estimate was off by ~70% on the recommended pick.
correction: Street to Kitchen is a 45-minute drive from the Hilton Houston Westchase. Drive-time claims in travel/dining recommendations must come from actual routing (Google Maps or equivalent), not lat/lng distance guesses, especially in Houston where freeway routing dominates straight-line distance.
systemic_fix: Proposed for Sterling's dining/travel research: when proximity drives the recommendation, verify drive times via Google Maps directions (Playwright) for at least the final shortlist before presenting. Label any remaining estimates as estimates.
